_about: ReanKhmer's simple romanization, used to show how a syllable sounds until it is recorded. Syllable = initial of the head consonant + initial of the subscript (if any) + the vowel for the syllable's series. Not a standard system (not UNGEGN or ALA-LC); it should read naturally to English speakers. needs_review: a Khmer teacher should check every vowel row.
_cluster_rule: Series of a cluster: the subscript's series, unless the subscript is a sonorant (listed below), in which case the head consonant's series. E.g. ស្រី stays a-series; ស្ពាន takes o-series from ព; ល្ខោន takes a-series from ខ. needs_review.
